summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the Veregen (sinecatechins / Polyphenon E) NDA021902 application. The medical review's dedicated section 8.5 (Advisory Committee Meeting) states plainly that none was held, and the filing checklist in the administrative correspondence likewise did not require one. With no AdComm, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
